```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from pathlib import Path
import yaml

# Read the CMS-managed YAML file
with Path("content/homepage.yml").open() as file:
    content = yaml.safe_load(file)

# Generate Markdown from the YAML content
print(f"## {content['title']}\n")
print(content["description"])
print(f"\n**Status:** {content['status']}")
```
